mcat_description.short: Prefabricated cabins are factory-built, portable modular structures assembled from steel frames and insulated sandwich panels, supplied as complete ready-to-install units for site offices, accommodation, security, and storage applications.
mcat_description.long: Prefabricated cabins are off-site manufactured modular structures built using steel or GI frames combined with insulated sandwich panels (PUF, GI, Aerocon, FRP, or cement board) and delivered to site as complete or knock-down units for rapid installation. In the Indian B2B market, they serve a wide range of applications — from construction site offices and labour accommodation to security guard cabins, portable toilets, and temporary retail kiosks — and are valued for their speed of deployment, relocatability, and cost advantage over conventional construction. Key structural variants include PUF sandwich panel cabins, GI panel cabins, Aerocon/cement board cabins, FRP cabins, and container-converted offices, with dimensions typically customised to buyer requirements. Manufacturers across India (concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and West Bengal) supply these as turnkey units including doors, windows, electrical fittings, and insulation, quoted per piece or per square foot depending on size and complexity.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, 'prefabricated cabin' and 'porta cabin' are used interchangeably to describe factory-built portable modular structures assembled from steel frames and insulated sandwich panels (PUF, GI, Aerocon, FRP, or cement board). The dominant commercial form is the steel-framed PUF sandwich panel cabin used for construction site offices and worker accommodation, with security guard cabins and portable toilet blocks as high-volume sub-segments. Manufacturers are concentrated in Delhi-NCR (Gurugram, Ghaziabad, Loni), Gujarat (Ahmedabad, Vadodara), Maharashtra, and West Bengal (Kolkata). Structural compliance references BIS codes and local municipal regulations; leading manufacturers cite ISO 9001:2015 certification and IS standards compliance. Key material variants — PUF, GI, Aerocon/cement board, FRP, and container steel — define distinct price and performance tiers, with PUF insulated cabins commanding a premium for thermal comfort. The market spans basic security kiosks at the entry level through to LGSF modular homes and luxury eco-resort cabins at the premium end, with construction-sector B2B procurement (site offices, labour camps) representing the highest-volume segment. Rental of site office containers is also a significant parallel market. Standard catalogue sizes include 10x10 ft, 8x20 ft, 10x20 ft, and 20x40 ft, with custom dimensions widely available.
